name: hostr
description: Hostr workspace validation, documentation and release tooling

scripts.analyze: (cd dependencies/nmdk/packages/marketplace_models && dart analyze) && (cd dependencies/nmdk/packages/marketplace_evm && dart analyze) && (cd hostr_sdk && dart analyze) && (cd escrow && dart analyze) && (cd app && flutter analyze)
scripts.test: (cd dependencies/nmdk/packages/marketplace_models && dart test) && (cd dependencies/nmdk/packages/marketplace_evm && dart test) && (cd hostr_sdk && dart test test/unit) && (cd escrow && dart test) && (cd app && flutter test)
scripts.check: npm run check:payment-boundary && npm run analyze && npm test
